AdvancedCriticals.title: Mace Criticals
AdvancedCriticals.description: Manual mace critical-hit packet mode. Hold a mace and attack to trigger its configured critical behavior.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Uses Alien's packet-sending mode.

noCrystal.title: No Crystal
noCrystal.description: In Swap mode, crystals are not attacked.

inventorySwap.title: Inventory Swap
inventorySwap.description: Searches the full inventory for a mace, not only the hotbar.

onlyGround.title: Only Ground
onlyGround.description: Triggers only while on the ground or while flying.

height.title: Height
height.description: Sets the spoofed height. Alien defaults to 25 and supports values up to 2000.

AdvancedFakePlayer.title: Advanced Fake Player
AdvancedFakePlayer.description: Spawns a damageable client-side fake player for combat testing. This experimental implementation is based on Meteor fake-player behavior.

health.title: Health
health.description: Sets the fake player's initial health.

copyInv.title: Copy Inv
copyInv.description: Copies your inventory items to the fake player.

simulateDamage.title: Simulate Damage
simulateDamage.description: Controls whether attack and explosion damage is simulated.

invulnerableTicks.title: Invulnerable Ticks
invulnerableTicks.description: Sets the invulnerability time after taking damage, in ticks. Vanilla defaults to 20; set it to 0 for maximum-DPS testing.

autoTotem.title: Auto Totem
autoTotem.description: Automatically holds a totem in the offhand and triggers it when the fake player would die.

showDamage.title: Show Damage
showDamage.description: Shows the amount of damage taken in chat.

AntiAntiXray.title: Anti Anti-Xray
AntiAntiXray.description: Probes nearby blocks to reveal server-provided block information and highlight likely ores. Effectiveness depends on the server anti-xray implementation.

triggerMode.title: Trigger Mode
triggerMode.description: Selects automatic scanning or manual key-triggered scanning.

forceScanKey.title: Force Scan Key
forceScanKey.description: Press this key to start scanning nearby blocks.

radius.title: Scan Radius
radius.description: Sets the radius of the scan area.

mode.title: Interaction Mode
mode.description: Selects how interaction packets are sent.

autoMine.title: Auto Mine
autoMine.description: When a real ore is discovered, lets Baritone automatically mine it.

mineThreshold.title: Mine Threshold
mineThreshold.description: Only interrupts tunneling to mine when at least this many real ores have been found.

tunnelMode.title: Tunnel Mode
tunnelMode.description: If no real ore is found, or too few are found, makes Baritone continue tunneling forward.

minDurability.title: Min Durability
minDurability.description: Forcibly stops Baritone when the main-hand tool durability drops below this threshold.

scanWaitMode.title: Scan Wait Mode
scanWaitMode.description: When enabled, tunneling periodically pauses until scanning finishes before continuing. The interval is controlled below. When disabled, scanning occurs immediately while moving as before.

tunnelScanInterval.title: Tunnel Scan Interval
tunnelScanInterval.description: While tunneling, pauses every configured number of seconds and scans nearby ores. Baritone waits while the scan is running.

scanWhileMining.title: Scan While Mining
scanWhileMining.description: When enabled, travel toward ores also pauses at the configured interval to scan nearby blocks. When disabled, interval scanning is skipped while mining.

scanOnMineComplete.title: Scan On Mine Complete
scanOnMineComplete.description: When enabled, performs a scan immediately after an ore-mining task finishes and waits for that scan to complete.

threadCount.title: Thread Count
threadCount.description: Sets how much or how many values are used for thread Count in Anti Anti-Xray.

blocksPerTick.title: Blocks Per Tick
blocksPerTick.description: Sets the numeric value for blocks Per Tick in Anti Anti-Xray.

delay.title: Packet Delay (Ticks)

dynamicReset.title: Dynamic Reset

otherColor.title: Other Color

targetBlocks.title: Target Blocks

renderTracers.title: Render Tracers
renderTracers.description: Controls whether render Tracers is shown by Anti Anti-Xray.

showProgress.title: Show Progress

renderScan.title: Render Scan
renderScan.description: Controls whether render Scan is shown by Anti Anti-Xray.

AttackRangeIndicator.title: Attack Range Indicator
AttackRangeIndicator.description: Visualizes attack reach, warning distance, and your effective melee range.

attackRange.title: Attack Range
attackRange.description: Sets the actual attack reach. Targets change color while inside this distance.

warningRange.title: Warning Range
warningRange.description: Sets the distance at which the warning display begins.

maxTargets.title: Max Targets
maxTargets.description: Limits how many target boxes can be rendered at once to reduce lag in dense areas such as mob farms. Set to 0 for no limit.

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects how the target boxes and rings are rendered.

showWarning.title: Show Warning
showWarning.description: Controls whether a warning is shown when a target is inside the warning range but outside attack reach.

renderSelf.title: Render Self
renderSelf.description: Renders a ring under your feet to show your current attack range.

renderTargetCircle.title: Render Target Circle
renderTargetCircle.description: Renders an additional ring beneath the target.

inRangeSideColor.title: In Range Side Color
inRangeSideColor.description: Sets the box fill color when a target is inside attack range.

inRangeLineColor.title: In Range Line Color
inRangeLineColor.description: Sets the box outline color when a target is inside attack range.

warningSideColor.title: Warning Side Color

warningLineColor.title: Warning Line Color
warningLineColor.description: Sets the box outline color when a target is inside the warning range.

targetCircleInRangeColor.title: Target Circle In Range Color
targetCircleInRangeColor.description: Sets the target foot-ring color while the target is inside attack range.

targetCircleWarningColor.title: Target Circle Warning Color
targetCircleWarningColor.description: Sets the target foot-ring color while the target is inside the warning range.

selfSideColor.title: Self Side Color
selfSideColor.description: Sets the self Side Color used when Attack Range Indicator renders this element.

selfLineColor.title: Self Line Color
selfLineColor.description: Sets the self Line Color used when Attack Range Indicator renders this element.

AttractAura.title: Attract Aura
AttractAura.description: Pulls your movement toward selected players like a magnet, with target selection and anti-kick controls.

toggleBehavior.title: Toggle Behavior
toggleBehavior.description: Selects the toggle Behavior option used by Attract Aura.

range.description: Sets the attraction Range used by Attract Aura.

speed.title: Attraction Speed
speed.description: Sets the movement or animation attraction Speed used by Attract Aura.

stopDistance.title: Stop Distance
stopDistance.description: Sets the stop Distance used by Attract Aura.

middleClickLock.title: Middle Click Lock
middleClickLock.description: Enables or disables middle Click Lock for Attract Aura.

antiKick.title: Anti Kick

kickDelay.title: Kick Delay
kickDelay.description: Sets how many ticks pass between anti-kick actions.

ignoreFriends.title: Ignore Friends
ignoreFriends.description: Enables or disables ignore Friends for Attract Aura.

followSurvival.title: Follow Survival
followSurvival.description: Enables or disables follow Survival for Attract Aura.

followAdventure.title: Follow Adventure
followAdventure.description: Enables or disables follow Adventure for Attract Aura.

followCreative.title: Follow Creative
followCreative.description: Enables or disables follow Creative for Attract Aura.

AutoChestAura.title: Auto Chest Aura
AutoChestAura.description: Automatically opens nearby configured containers at high speed. Intended for container scanning and ChestTracker-style workflows.

range.title: Open Range
range.description: Sets the maximum distance at which containers can be opened.

blocks.title: Container Types
blocks.description: Selects which container types may be opened.

delay.title: Open Interval
delay.description: Sets the cooldown, in ticks, before opening the next container.

waitTime.title: Wait Time
waitTime.description: Sets how many ticks to wait after receiving container data before closing it, giving ChestTracker time to process the contents.

timeout.title: Force Timeout
timeout.description: If a container gets stuck open, forcibly closes it after this many ticks to prevent lockups.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.description: Automatically rotates toward a container when opening it.

AutoChorus.title: Auto Chorus Flower
AutoChorus.description: Automatically aims and fires bows, crossbows, or projectiles at chorus flowers to speed up harvesting.

range.title: Attack Range
range.description: Sets the maximum attack distance.

autoSwitch.title: Auto Switch
autoSwitch.description: Automatically switches to a ranged weapon from the inventory.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.description: Automatically rotates the view to aim at the target.

delay.title: Shot Delay
delay.description: Sets the cooldown after firing, in ticks.

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects the shape Mode option used by Auto Chorus Flower.

sideColor.title: Side Color
sideColor.description: Sets the side Color used when Auto Chorus Flower renders this element.

lineColor.title: Line Color
lineColor.description: Sets the line Color used when Auto Chorus Flower renders this element.

AutoDeoxidizer.title: Auto Deoxidizer
AutoDeoxidizer.description: Automatically switches to an axe when using copper or logs so you can scrape oxidation, remove wax, or strip logs.

stripLogs.title: Strip Logs
stripLogs.description: Automatically converts logs into stripped logs.

removeWax.title: Remove Wax
removeWax.description: Also removes wax from waxed copper blocks.

checkHand.title: Check Hand
checkHand.description: If you are already holding an axe, automatic switching is skipped.

handBlacklist.title: Hand Blacklist
handBlacklist.description: The feature will not trigger while holding any item in this blacklist.

checkInventory.title: Check Inventory
checkInventory.description: If no axe is available in the hotbar, searches the inventory and temporarily moves one for use.

AutoFirework.title: Auto Firework
AutoFirework.description: Automatically uses fireworks for elytra flight. This is an experimental utility.

keybind.title: Keybind
keybind.description: The key to press to use a firework.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: The delay between using fireworks in ticks.

AutoJump.title: Auto Jump
AutoJump.description: Continuously jumps and can alternate sneaking states for movement or entertainment.

sneakWhileJumping.title: Sneak While Jumping
sneakWhileJumping.description: Repeatedly alternates between sneaking and standing while jumping. This is mainly an entertainment option.

sneakStandDelay.title: Sneak Stand Delay
sneakStandDelay.description: Sets how long each standing phase lasts, in ticks.

sneakDuration.title: Sneak Duration
sneakDuration.description: Sets how long each sneak press lasts, in ticks.

jumpDelay.title: Jump Delay
jumpDelay.description: Sets the interval between jumps, in ticks. Lower values jump more frequently.

AutoKouZi.title: Auto Trash Talk
AutoKouZi.description: Automatically sends messages from the configured list, including optional whisper and command modes.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Sets the delay between sent messages, in seconds.

autoDisable.title: Auto Disable
autoDisable.description: Automatically disables the module when you disconnect.

commandMode.title: Command Mode
commandMode.description: Forces outgoing text to be sent as commands.

defaultMessage.title: Default Message
defaultMessage.description: Sets the message used when the configured list is empty.

randomLength.title: Random Length
randomLength.description: Sets the length of random garbage text appended to each message.

randomWhisper.title: Random Whisper
randomWhisper.description: Randomly selects an online player as the whisper target.

targetPlayer.title: Target Player
targetPlayer.description: Sets the player ID used as the whisper target.

whisperCmd.title: Whisper Cmd
whisperCmd.description: Sets the private-message command, for example msg, tell, or w.

checkSelf.title: Check Self
checkSelf.description: Excludes your own player name when choosing a random whisper target.

AutoMessage.title: Scheduled Messages
AutoMessage.description: Sends configured commands or chat messages on a schedule. It can also cycle song commands on servers with a /music command.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Selects the entries used by messages in Scheduled Messages. This value is measured in seconds.

defaultDelay.title: Default Delay
defaultDelay.description: Sets the default wait time, in seconds, when an entry does not specify its own delay.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Restarts from the beginning after the list finishes.

random.title: Random
random.description: Randomly selects entries from the valid list instead of running them in order.

onlySelected.title: Only Selected
onlySelected.description: When enabled, only entries beginning with the configured selection prefix are sent.

selectPrefix.title: Select Prefix
selectPrefix.description: Sets the symbol used to mark selected entries.

AutoNod.title: Auto Nod
AutoNod.description: Automatically moves the view in nodding, shaking, circular, random, or sleepy patterns using packet or visible modes.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Selects the motion pattern.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Selects the visibility option used by Auto Nod.

sleepWait.title: Sleep Wait
sleepWait.description: Sets the portion of the sleepy animation spent holding the head down, from 0.0 to 0.8.

wakeUpSpeed.title: Wake Up Speed
wakeUpSpeed.description: Sets wake-up speed. Higher values raise the head faster.

AutoRespawn.title: Auto Respawn
AutoRespawn.description: Automatically respawns after death and can run configured messages or commands after respawning.

showMessage.title: Show Message
showMessage.description: Shows local feedback when you respawn. Only you can see this message.

actionMode.title: Action Mode
actionMode.description: Selects what action is performed after respawning.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Sets the delay before sending messages or commands, in ticks. 20 ticks equals 1 second.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Sets one or more messages or commands to send after respawn. Commands must begin with /.

AutoServer.title: Auto Server
AutoServer.description: Runs a different ordered command list automatically after joining each configured server address.

initialDelay.title: Initial Delay
initialDelay.description: Sets the delay after joining a server before the first command is executed.

commandInterval.title: Command Interval
commandInterval.description: Sets the delay between consecutive commands. 20 ticks equals 1 second.

showFeedback.title: Show Feedback
showFeedback.description: Shows command-send feedback and debugging information.

s1Enabled.title: S1 Enabled
s1Enabled.description: Enables or disables this server profile.

s1Ip.title: S1 IP
s1Ip.description: Sets the server IP that activates this profile, for example mcyanglao.com.

s1Cmds.title: S1 Cmds
s1Cmds.description: Sets the commands to execute in order after joining this server.

s2Enabled.title: S2 Enabled
s2Enabled.description: Enables or disables s2 Enabled for Auto Server.

s2Ip.title: S2 IP
s2Ip.description: Sets the text or value used for s2 IP in Auto Server.

s2Cmds.title: S2 Cmds

s3Enabled.title: S3 Enabled

s3Ip.title: S3 IP
s3Ip.description: Sets the text or value used for s3 IP in Auto Server.

s3Cmds.title: S3 Cmds
s3Cmds.description: Selects the entries used by s3 Cmds in Auto Server.

AutoSmithing.title: Auto Smithing
AutoSmithing.description: Automates smithing-table operations for netherite upgrades or armor trims.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Selects whether to upgrade equipment or apply armor trims.

delay.title: Action Delay
delay.description: Sets the action Delay used to pace or time actions in Auto Smithing.

autoDrop.title: Auto Drop
autoDrop.description: Enables or disables auto Drop behavior in Auto Smithing.

upgradeTargets.title: Upgrade Targets
upgradeTargets.description: Selects which diamond equipment pieces should be upgraded to netherite.

trimTargets.title: Trim Targets
trimTargets.description: Selects which armor pieces should receive trims.

trimTemplates.title: Trim Templates
trimTemplates.description: Restricts the module to the selected smithing templates.

trimMaterials.title: Trim Materials
trimMaterials.description: Restricts the module to the selected trim materials and colors.

AutoTPAccept.title: Auto TPA Accept
AutoTPAccept.description: Automatically clicks matching chat actions to accept or deny teleport requests such as TPA prompts.

action.title: Action Mode
action.description: Selects whether matching requests are automatically accepted or automatically denied.

onlyFriends.title: Only Friends
onlyFriends.description: Only handles requests from players in your Meteor friends list.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Triggers request scanning when chat contains any of these keywords.

delay.title: Delay (Ticks)
delay.description: Sets how many ticks to wait after receiving a request before handling it.

customKeywords.title: Custom Keywords
customKeywords.description: In Custom mode, sets the keyword list. Each keyword corresponds by index to the command below.

customCommands.title: Custom Commands
customCommands.description: In Custom mode, sets the command list. Detecting keyword [n] executes command [n].

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Shows detailed logs in chat for debugging.

ChatFilter.title: Chat Filter
ChatFilter.description: Locally replaces configured offensive words in chat with asterisks before they are displayed.

badWords.title: Bad Words

replacementChar.title: Replacement Char

openOpacity.title: Open Opacity

specificStrikethrough.description: Enables or disables specific Strikethrough for Chat Highlight.

targetCreative.title: Target Creative

targetAdventure.title: Target Adventure
targetAdventure.description: Enables or disables target Adventure for Crossbow Aura.

middleClickLock.title: Middle Click Lock
middleClickLock.description: Allows the middle mouse button to lock the player under the crosshair.

range.title: Tracking Range
range.description: Sets the maximum distance used to search for players.

speed.title: Flight Speed
speed.description: Sets forward propulsion speed while following a target.

stopDistance.title: Stop Distance
stopDistance.description: Stops propulsion when you get within this distance of the target to reduce clipping through it.

lookAt.title: Look At
lookAt.description: Automatically turns your view toward the target while flying.

autoTakeoff.title: Auto Takeoff
autoTakeoff.description: Automatically jumps and deploys the elytra when you are on the ground.

takeoffDelay.title: Takeoff Delay
takeoffDelay.description: Sets the delay between automatic takeoff checks.

followSurvival.title: Follow Survival
followSurvival.description: Enables or disables follow Survival for Elytra Follower.

followAdventure.title: Follow Adventure
followAdventure.description: Enables or disables follow Adventure for Elytra Follower.

followCreative.title: Follow Creative
followCreative.description: Enables or disables follow Creative for Elytra Follower.

followSpectator.title: Follow Spectator
followSpectator.description: Enables or disables follow Spectator for Elytra Follower.

FastCrossbow.title: Fast Crossbow
FastCrossbow.description: Rapidly charges and fires bows or crossbows using native, control, or packet-oriented firing modes.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Selects the firing mode. Native is the smoothest and recommended; Control aims for maximum speed; Packet is the most aggressive packet mode.

delay.title: Shot Delay
delay.description: Sets the post-shot cooldown in ticks. Recommended: Native 2-3 ticks; Control/Packet 3-5 ticks.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Applies only to Control and Packet modes. Holds the charge for a few extra ticks to reduce server rollback.

FeedbackBlocker.title: Feedback Blocker
FeedbackBlocker.description: Suppresses local chat messages that contain configured feedback or spam phrases.

ignoreCase.title: Ignore Case
ignoreCase.description: When enabled, matching ignores letter case, so 'placed' can also block 'Placed'.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Blocks a message when it contains any configured phrase in full.

FlightAntiKick.title: Flight Anti-Kick
FlightAntiKick.description: Periodically performs configurable downward or packet movement to reduce flight anti-kick timeouts.

mode.title: Anti-Kick Mode
mode.description: Selects anti-kick behavior: Physical Dip directly changes velocity; Packet Dip only sends a lower-position packet; Vertical Gravity continuously applies a small downward motion.

delay.title: Base Interval
delay.description: Sets the interval between anti-kick actions. A value around 25-35 is recommended.

dipDistance.title: Dip Distance
dipDistance.description: Sets the downward displacement distance. Around 0.04 is recommended for vanilla flight checks.

onlyIfActive.title: Only If Active
onlyIfActive.description: Only operates while Meteor's Flight module is active.

useRandom.title: Use Random
useRandom.description: Enables or disables use Random for Flight Anti-Kick.

randomRange.title: Random Range
randomRange.description: Sets the random Range used by Flight Anti-Kick.

GrimCriticals.title: Grim Criticals
GrimCriticals.description: Experimental critical-hit behavior intended for Grim-style environments.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The mode to use for criticals.

multitask.title: Multitask
multitask.description: Allows criticals to work while using other modules like Surround.

phasedOnly.title: Phased Only
phasedOnly.description: Only performs criticals when phased (for Grim modes).

wallsOnly.title: Walls Only
wallsOnly.description: Only checks for walls when Phased Only is enabled.

moveFix.title: Move Fix
moveFix.description: Prevents criticals while moving to avoid flag.

pauseOnCA.title: Pause On CA
pauseOnCA.description: Pauses Criticals when Crystal Aura is active.

HexChat.title: Hex Chat
HexChat.description: Formats outgoing chat with solid, gradient, four-color, rainbow, or vanilla color styles when the server supports hex formatting.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Selects how chat text colors are generated.

color.title: Solid Color
color.description: Sets the color used in Solid mode.

color1.title: Color1
color1.description: Sets the starting color of the gradient, for example gold.

color2.title: Color2
color2.description: Sets the second gradient color, for example green.

color3.title: Color3
color3.description: Sets the third gradient color, for example blue.

color4.title: Color4
color4.description: Sets the ending gradient color, for example pink.

rainbowSpread.title: Rainbow Spread
rainbowSpread.description: Controls how frequently rainbow colors change across a sentence. Lower values produce slower color changes.

vanillaColor.title: Vanilla Color
vanillaColor.description: Selects one of Minecraft's vanilla color codes (&0-9 and &a-f).

ignoreCommands.title: Ignore Commands
ignoreCommands.description: Leaves commands beginning with / unchanged so formatting does not break them.

HitboxESP.title: Hitbox ESP
HitboxESP.description: Renders configurable entity or player hitboxes for easier range and collision awareness.

ignoreSelf.title: Ignore Self
ignoreSelf.description: Does not render your own hitbox.

lineWidth.title: Line Width
lineWidth.description: Sets the line Width used by Hitbox ESP.

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects outline-only, filled, or combined hitbox rendering.

sideColor.title: Side Color
sideColor.description: Sets the fill color inside rendered hitboxes.

lineColor.title: Line Color
lineColor.description: Sets the color of hitbox edge lines.

InfiniteChat.title: Infinite Chat
InfiniteChat.description: Removes the normal client chat input length limit so very long messages or commands can be entered.

infiniteChatBox.title: Infinite Chat Box
infiniteChatBox.description: Removes the normal 256-character chat-box limit using the unrestricted mode.

ItemDespawnTimer.title: Item Despawn Timer
ItemDespawnTimer.description: Shows a countdown above dropped items indicating how long remains before they despawn.

scale.title: Text Scale
scale.description: Sets the displayed countdown text size.

heightOffset.title: Height Offset
heightOffset.description: Sets how far above the dropped item the countdown text appears.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Sets custom text shown before the countdown.

blink.title: Blink
blink.description: Makes the text flash red when fewer than 10 seconds remain.

playSound.title: Play Sound
playSound.description: Plays a notification sound shortly before an item despawns.

soundType.title: Sound Type
soundType.description: Selects the notification sound to play.

backgroundColor.title: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Sets the color of the label background panel.

colorMode.title: Color Mode
colorMode.description: Selects how countdown text color is calculated.

staticColor.title: Static Color
staticColor.description: Sets the text color used in Static mode.

startColor.title: Start Color
startColor.description: Sets the color used while plenty of despawn time remains, for example green.

middleColor.title: Middle Color
middleColor.description: Sets the color used around roughly one minute remaining, for example yellow.

endColor.title: End Color
endColor.description: Sets the color used when the item is about to disappear, for example red.

KnockbackDirection.title: Knockback Direction
KnockbackDirection.description: Adjusts your facing direction around attacks to influence knockback direction. It is not intended to bypass server anti-cheat.

yawOffset.title: Yaw Offset
yawOffset.description: Rotation relative to your current view. 180 = Pull towards you, 90 = To the left.

recoilPercent.title: Recoil Percent
recoilPercent.description: How much to twitch back towards original view (0-1).

modifierKey.title: Modifier Key
modifierKey.description: Sets the keybind for modifier Key in Knockback Direction.

scrollStep.title: Scroll Step
scrollStep.description: Sets the numeric value for scroll Step in Knockback Direction.

MaceAura.title: Mace Aura
MaceAura.description: Automatically attacks nearby targets with a mace and can switch weapons or apply configured timing.

range.title: Range
range.description: Sets the attack range.

autoSwitch.title: Auto Switch
autoSwitch.description: Automatically switches to a mace before attacking.

allowFlight.title: Allow Flight
allowFlight.description: Allows attacks while flying or otherwise airborne.

swingHand.title: Swing Hand
swingHand.description: Shows the hand-swing animation when attacking.

attackDelay.title: Attack Delay
attackDelay.description: Sets attack delay in ticks. A value around 15 is recommended.

critHeight.title: Crit Height
critHeight.description: Sets the spoofed falling height. Very high values above roughly 100 may cause timeout kicks.

autoHeight.title: Auto Height
autoHeight.description: Automatically checks blocks above you and chooses a safer critical-hit height.

players.title: Players
players.description: Controls whether players are valid attack targets.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Selects the specific living entity types that may be attacked.

throughWalls.title: Through Walls
throughWalls.description: Allows attacks through walls by ignoring line-of-sight checks.

ignoreNamed.title: Ignore Named
ignoreNamed.description: Does not attack mobs that have custom names.

ignoreTamed.title: Ignore Tamed
ignoreTamed.description: Does not attack tamed mobs or pets.

listMode.title: List Mode
listMode.description: Selects whitelist or blacklist behavior for the player list.

playerList.title: Player List
playerList.description: Sets the player list, separated with English commas (,).

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects the target rendering mode.

MaceBreakerPro.title: Mace Breaker Pro
MaceBreakerPro.description: Rapidly switches equipment around attacks to interrupt or enhance mace-related combat actions. Anti-cheat compatibility is limited.

swordTrigger.title: Sword Trigger
swordTrigger.description: Triggers when attacking while holding a sword.

axeTrigger.title: Axe Trigger
axeTrigger.description: Triggers when attacking while holding an axe.

maceTrigger.title: Mace Trigger
maceTrigger.description: Triggers when attacking while holding a mace.

onlyOnShield.title: Only On Shield
onlyOnShield.description: Only executes while the enemy is actively raising a shield, reducing wasted durability and unnecessary actions.

legitMode.title: Legit Mode
legitMode.description: In Legit mode, forcibly synchronizes the client-selected slot to reduce Grim inventory-detection issues.

autoReturn.title: Auto Return
autoReturn.description: Switches back to the original weapon after the sequence completes.

MaceDMGPlus.title: Mace Damage Plus
MaceDMGPlus.description: Experimental high-damage mace movement and packet logic with target filters, rendering, and optional totem-bypass behavior. Best suited to servers without strict anti-cheat.

range.title: Detection Range
range.description: Sets the maximum distance for automatically attacking enemies.

autoSwitch.title: Auto Switch
autoSwitch.description: Automatically switches to a mace when attacking.

silentSwap.title: Silent Swap
silentSwap.description: Switches weapons with packets, without normal animation or sound, making the swap less visible to other players.

attackDelay.title: Attack Delay
attackDelay.description: Sets the automatic attack interval in ticks. Around 15 is recommended; values that are too low may cause kicks.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.description: Forcibly rotates your view toward the target when attacking.

preventDeath.title: Prevent Death
preventDeath.description: Attempts to prevent fall death caused by spoofed height. Enabling this is recommended.

maxPower.title: Max Power
maxPower.description: Simulates a fall from about 170 blocks for maximum mace damage on Paper/Spigot-style servers. It is normally unnecessary on vanilla servers.

fallHeight.title: Fall Height
fallHeight.description: Sets the spoofed fall height. The default value of 22 is intended to work in low-ceiling areas while reducing kick risk.

airCheck.title: Air Check
airCheck.description: When enabled, checks for free space overhead for safer anti-cheat behavior. When disabled, packets are forced regardless of terrain, allowing use in roughly two-block-high spaces but with greater risk.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Selects the specific living entity types that may be attacked.

throughWalls.title: Through Walls
throughWalls.description: Allows attacking through walls without line-of-sight checks.

ignoreNamed.title: Ignore Named
ignoreNamed.description: Does not attack entities with custom name tags.

ignoreTamed.title: Ignore Tamed
ignoreTamed.description: Does not attack tamed entities or pets.

ignoreFriends.title: Ignore Friends
ignoreFriends.description: Excludes Meteor friends from attack targeting.

listMode.title: List Mode
listMode.description: Selects list filtering: Whitelist attacks only listed players; Blacklist avoids listed players and attacks others.

playerList.title: Player List
playerList.description: Sets player names separated with English commas (,).

render.title: Render Target
render.description: Draws a box around the selected target.

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects the shape Mode option used by Mace Damage Plus.

sideColor.title: Side Color
sideColor.description: Sets the side Color used when Mace Damage Plus renders this element.

lineColor.title: Line Color
lineColor.description: Sets the line Color used when Mace Damage Plus renders this element.

totemBypass.title: Totem Bypass
totemBypass.description: Performs multiple rapid attacks in an attempt to get through totem invulnerability timing.

totemAttacks.title: Totem Attacks
totemAttacks.description: Sets the number of consecutive attacks, from 1 to 3.

totemHeightIncrease.title: Totem Height Increase
totemHeightIncrease.description: Adds this many blocks of spoofed fall height for each additional attack.

MassTpa.title: Mass TPA
MassTpa.description: Automatically sends /tpa requests to online players and can stop when somebody accepts.

delay.title: Send Interval
delay.description: Sets the interval, in seconds, between TPA requests sent to different players.

command.title: Command
command.description: Sets the command to send; do not include a player name.

ignoreFriends.title: Ignore Friends
ignoreFriends.description: Does not send requests to players in your Meteor friends list.

randomOrder.title: Random Order
randomOrder.description: Randomizes the player order instead of using alphabetical order.

stopOnTeleport.title: Stop On Teleport
stopOnTeleport.description: Stops the module when a large coordinate change indicates that a teleport succeeded.

stopOnChat.title: Stop On Chat
stopOnChat.description: Stops the module when chat contains configured success keywords.

successKeywords.title: Success Keywords
successKeywords.description: Treats a chat message as a successful TPA acceptance when it contains any word in this list.

debugChat.title: Debug Chat
debugChat.description: Shows every raw server chat message locally to make it easier to capture success keywords for configuration.

MineESP.title: Mining ESP
MineESP.description: Highlights blocks that other players are currently mining.

range.title: Render Range
range.description: Only renders mining activity within this range.

maxTime.title: Max Time
maxTime.description: Sets how many seconds a mining box remains visible and fades after mining stops.

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects which parts of the mining box are rendered.

lineColor.title: Line Color
lineColor.description: Sets the outline color of the item box.

sideColor.title: Side Color
sideColor.description: Sets the color of the box sides.

renderName.title: Render Name
renderName.description: Shows the miner's name inside the box.

renderProgress.title: Render Progress
renderProgress.description: Shows mining progress as a percentage.

smoothProgress.title: Smooth Progress
smoothProgress.description: Simulates a smooth 1-100 progress value for visual presentation.

renderBlock.title: Render Block
renderBlock.description: Shows the name of the block currently being mined.

textScale.title: Text Scale
textScale.description: Sets the scale of miner names and progress text.

ModuleList.title: Module List Plus
ModuleList.description: Displays a configurable on-screen list of active modules, inspired by LeavesHack-style module lists.

additionalInfo.title: Additional Info
additionalInfo.description: Shows additional module information such as the current [Mode].

onlyBind.title: Only Bind
onlyBind.description: Only shows modules that have a keybind assigned.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Enables or disables shadow for Module List Plus.

moduleColor.title: Module Color
moduleColor.description: Sets the module Color used when Module List Plus renders this element.

activeColor.title: Active Color
activeColor.description: Sets the color used for active-state additional information.

background.title: Background
background.description: Sets the background used when Module List Plus renders this element.

tagColor.title: Tag Color
tagColor.description: Sets the color of the small vertical tag bar on the right.

MusicPlayer.title: Music Player
MusicPlayer.description: Cycles songs through a server /music command and supports user-provided playlist text files.

mode.title: Run Mode
mode.description: Selects how the music player operates.

delay.title: Send Interval (Seconds)
delay.description: Sets how many seconds pass before the next command is sent.

currentLine.title: Current Line
currentLine.description: Sets the current playlist line number and playback progress. It can be edited manually.

triggerPrefix.title: Trigger Prefix
triggerPrefix.description: Sets the chat prefix used to recognize song requests, for example a prefix followed by a song ID such as '#song 1'.

listenToOthers.title: Listen To Others
listenToOthers.description: Controls whether song-request commands sent by other players are accepted.

OreVeinESP.title: Ore Vein ESP
OreVeinESP.description: Highlights exposed ore veins and can be configured for specific blocks or safer surface-only scanning.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Safe mode scans only ores exposed to the surface.

blocks.title: Target Blocks
blocks.description: Selects the ore blocks to scan for.

radius.title: Scan Radius
radius.description: Sets the horizontal scan radius in chunks.

yMin.title: Y Min
yMin.description: Sets the lowest Y level included in scanning.

yMax.title: Y Max
yMax.description: Sets the highest Y level included in scanning.

scanDelay.title: Scan Delay
scanDelay.description: Sets the interval, in ticks, between background scans.

autoMine.title: Auto Mine
autoMine.description: Lets Baritone automatically mine exposed ores found by the scanner.

autoMineRange.title: Auto Mine Range
autoMineRange.description: Only sends Baritone to ores within this many blocks of the player, preventing it from chasing very distant targets.

renderLimit.title: Render Limit
renderLimit.description: Limits the number of rendered blocks to reduce FPS loss.

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects how ore blocks are rendered.

useAutoColor.title: Use Auto Color
useAutoColor.description: Automatically chooses a color by ore type, such as blue for diamond and yellow for gold.

customColor.title: Custom Color
customColor.description: Sets one shared color for all ores when automatic colors are disabled.

PearlPhase.title: Pearl Phase
PearlPhase.description: Helps remain inside blocks after pearl phasing and can reduce suffocation-style visual obstruction.

antiPush.title: Anti Push
antiPush.description: Prevents the client from pushing you out of a block.

removeOverlay.title: Remove Overlay
removeOverlay.description: Removes the inside-block screen overlay so you can see outward as if the block were transparent.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Sets the movement multiplier while inside blocks.

PortalESP.title: Portal ESP
PortalESP.description: Draws configurable boxes around Nether portals, End portals, and End gateways.

netherEnabled.title: Nether Enabled
netherEnabled.description: Shows through-wall boxes around Nether portal blocks.

netherShapeMode.title: Nether Shape Mode
netherShapeMode.description: Selects the nether Shape Mode option used by Portal ESP.

netherSideColor.title: Nether Side Color
netherSideColor.description: Sets the nether Side Color used when Portal ESP renders this element.

netherLineColor.title: Nether Line Color
netherLineColor.description: Sets the nether Line Color used when Portal ESP renders this element.

endEnabled.title: End Enabled
endEnabled.description: Shows through-wall boxes around End portal blocks.

endShapeMode.title: End Shape Mode
endShapeMode.description: Selects the end Shape Mode option used by Portal ESP.

endSideColor.title: End Side Color
endSideColor.description: Sets the end Side Color used when Portal ESP renders this element.

endLineColor.title: End Line Color
endLineColor.description: Sets the end Line Color used when Portal ESP renders this element.

gatewayEnabled.title: Gateway Enabled
gatewayEnabled.description: Shows through-wall boxes around End Gateway blocks.

gatewayShapeMode.title: Gateway Shape Mode
gatewayShapeMode.description: Selects the gateway Shape Mode option used by Portal ESP.

gatewaySideColor.title: Gateway Side Color
gatewaySideColor.description: Sets the gateway Side Color used when Portal ESP renders this element.

gatewayLineColor.title: Gateway Line Color
gatewayLineColor.description: Sets the gateway Line Color used when Portal ESP renders this element.

renderDistance.title: Render Distance
renderDistance.description: Only renders portal blocks within this distance.

RTsearch.title: RT Search
RTsearch.description: Repeatedly sends a configured random-teleport command such as /rt or /rtp.

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: Distance to get within (supports k/m, e.g., 10k = 10000, 1.5m = 1500000).

rtpCommand.title: Rtp Command
rtpCommand.description: Sets the teleport command without the leading slash, for example rt, rtp, or wild.

disconnectOnReach.title: Disconnect On Reach
disconnectOnReach.description: Disconnect when reaching the target coordinates or finding the target biome.

rtpDelay.title: Rtp Delay
rtpDelay.description: Delay between RTP attempts in seconds.

selfPing.title: Self Ping
selfPing.description: Ping yourself in the webhook message.

discordId.title: Discord ID
discordId.description: Your Discord user ID for pinging.

ShieldESP.title: Shield ESP
ShieldESP.description: Renders the approximate defensive arc of players or yourself while a shield is raised.

renderSelf.title: Render Self
renderSelf.description: Controls whether your own shield-defense area is rendered.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Sets the radius of the defensive arc.

height.title: Height Offset
height.description: Sets the vertical position of the arc relative to the player's feet.

shapeMode.title: Shape Mode
shapeMode.description: Selects how the defensive arc is rendered.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Sets the number of segments used to smooth the edge of the arc.

otherSideColor.title: Other Side Color
otherSideColor.description: Sets the fill color of other players' defensive arcs.

otherLineColor.title: Other Line Color
otherLineColor.description: Sets the outline color of other players' defensive arcs.

selfSideColor.title: Self Side Color
selfSideColor.description: Sets the fill color of your own defensive arc.

selfLineColor.title: Self Line Color
selfLineColor.description: Sets the outline color of your own defensive arc.

SpearExploit.title: Spear Exploit
SpearExploit.description: Experimental spear movement logic that adds momentum before a spear attack. Intended mainly for testing or entertainment.

range.title: Maximum Detection Range
range.description: Sets the maximum maximum Detection Range used by Spear Exploit.

minRange.title: Min Range
minRange.description: Sets the minimum run-up distance. Distances that are too short, such as one block, may not let the server calculate enough speed. At least about 2.5 blocks is recommended.

speed.title: Charge Speed
speed.description: Sets physical charge velocity. Values above about 4.0 can pass through enemies without dealing damage; roughly 2.5-3.5 is recommended.

minChargeTicks.title: Min Charge Ticks
minChargeTicks.description: Sets the numeric value for min Charge Ticks in Spear Exploit. This value is measured in ticks.

packetRotate.title: Packet Rotate
packetRotate.description: Sends extra rotation packets so the server sees you facing the target, reducing attacks that pass through without damage.

SwordGap.title: Sword Gap
SwordGap.description: Provides sword-and-gapple interaction behavior similar to the corresponding Meteor feature.

allowedFoods.title: Allowed Foods
allowedFoods.description: Select which items are allowed to be eaten.

TargetStrafe.title: Target Strafe
TargetStrafe.description: Automatically circles a selected target with configurable radius, speed, and movement behavior.

mode.title: Movement Mode
mode.description: Selects the movement algorithm used to circle the target.

executeMode.title: Execute Mode
executeMode.description: Selects when movement logic runs. The Move-event mode is usually smoother.

targetRange.title: Target Range
targetRange.description: Sets the maximum range used to find a target.

targetCreative.title: Target Creative
targetCreative.description: Controls whether players in Creative mode are valid targets.

targetAdventure.title: Target Adventure
targetAdventure.description: Controls whether players in Adventure mode are valid targets.

radius.title: Strafe Radius
radius.description: Sets the distance maintained from the target while circling.

speed.title: Strafe Speed
speed.description: Sets the base speed used to move around the target.

scrollSpeed.title: Scroll Speed
scrollSpeed.description: Sets the additional speed factor used in Scroll mode.

damageBoost.title: Damage Boost
damageBoost.description: Temporarily increases movement speed after you take damage.

boost.title: Boost
boost.description: Sets the extra movement speed added after taking damage.

TntBomber.title: B-2 Bomber
TntBomber.description: Places and ignites TNT below you while flying, using supported ignition items. Intended as an entertainment bomber module.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Sets the interval between TNT placements, in ticks.

onlyWhenFlying.title: Only When Flying
onlyWhenFlying.description: Only activates while you are flying with an elytra.

requireRightClick.title: Require Right Click
requireRightClick.description: Requires the right mouse button to be held for activation.

TpAnchor.title: Teleport Anchor Strike
TpAnchor.description: Teleports into attack range, places and charges a respawn anchor, and detonates it against a selected target.

range.title: Strike Range
range.description: Sets the radius used to search for targets.

attackDelay.title: Attack Delay
attackDelay.description: Sets the attack Delay used to pace or time actions in Teleport Anchor Strike.

pauseOnEat.title: Pause On Eat
pauseOnEat.description: Enables or disables pause On Eat for Teleport Anchor Strike.

autoRefill.title: Auto Refill
autoRefill.description: Enables or disables auto Refill behavior in Teleport Anchor Strike.

placeRange.title: Place Range
placeRange.description: Sets the place Range used by Teleport Anchor Strike.

tpMode.title: TP Mode
tpMode.description: Selects teleport behavior: Vanilla respects normal limits; Paper uses higher packet activity to work around some server restrictions.

goUp.title: Go Up
goUp.description: Performs a vertical clip to move through terrain collision.

vanillaPackets.title: Vanilla Packets
vanillaPackets.description: Sets the numeric value for vanilla Packets in Teleport Anchor Strike.

paperPackets.title: Paper Packets
paperPackets.description: Sets the numeric value for paper Packets in Teleport Anchor Strike.

horizontalOffset.title: Horizontal Offset
horizontalOffset.description: Sets the numeric value for horizontal Offset in Teleport Anchor Strike.

yOffset.title: Y Offset
yOffset.description: Sets the numeric value for Y Offset in Teleport Anchor Strike.

skipCollisionCheck.title: Skip Collision Check
skipCollisionCheck.description: If BoatNoclip is active, skips the block-collision check. This behavior originates from the Trouser-Streak implementation.

airPlace.title: Air Place
airPlace.description: Enables or disables air Place for Teleport Anchor Strike.

autoProtect.title: Auto Protect
autoProtect.description: Enables or disables auto Protect behavior in Teleport Anchor Strike.

shieldBlocks.title: Shield Blocks
shieldBlocks.description: Selects the entries used by shield Blocks in Teleport Anchor Strike.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Selects the entries used by entities in Teleport Anchor Strike.

ignoreFriends.title: Ignore Friends
ignoreFriends.description: Excludes Meteor friends from attack targeting.

ignoreNamed.title: Ignore Named
ignoreNamed.description: Excludes named entities from attack targeting.

ignoreTamed.title: Ignore Tamed
ignoreTamed.description: Excludes tamed creatures from attack targeting.

attackSurvival.title: Attack Survival
attackSurvival.description: Enables or disables attack Survival for Teleport Anchor Strike.

attackCreative.title: Attack Creative
attackCreative.description: Enables or disables attack Creative for Teleport Anchor Strike.

attackAdventure.title: Attack Adventure
attackAdventure.description: Enables or disables attack Adventure for Teleport Anchor Strike.

listMode.title: List Mode
listMode.description: Selects the list Mode option used by Teleport Anchor Strike.

playerList.title: Player List
playerList.description: Sets the text or value used for player List in Teleport Anchor Strike.

renderTarget.title: Render Target
renderTarget.description: Controls whether render Target is shown by Teleport Anchor Strike.

sideColor.title: Side Color
sideColor.description: Sets the side Color used when Teleport Anchor Strike renders this element.

lineColor.title: Line Color
lineColor.description: Sets the line Color used when Teleport Anchor Strike renders this element.

renderPath.title: Render Path
renderPath.description: Controls whether render Path is shown by Teleport Anchor Strike.

targetColor.title: Target Color
targetColor.description: Sets the target Color used when Teleport Anchor Strike renders this element.

pathColor.title: Path Color
pathColor.description: Sets the path Color used when Teleport Anchor Strike renders this element.

debug.title: Debug Information
debug.description: Enables or disables debug Information for Teleport Anchor Strike.

TpAura.title: Teleport Aura
TpAura.description: Teleports around selected targets and performs attacks using configurable targeting, compatibility, and rendering options.

attackMode.title: Attack Mode
attackMode.description: Selects the attack Mode option used by Teleport Aura.

cooldownThreshold.title: Cooldown Threshold
cooldownThreshold.description: Sets the weapon charge threshold. A value of 1.0 means full damage.

attackDelay.title: Attack Delay
attackDelay.description: Sets the attack Delay used to pace or time actions in Teleport Aura. This value is measured in ticks.

blockScanInterval.description: Sets the tick interval between updates of nearby block-scan results.

signTextScan.title: Sign Text Scan
signTextScan.description: When scanning signs, wall signs, and hanging signs, displays non-empty text from both the front and back sides.

missionScan.title: Mission Scan
missionScan.description: Enables priority scan missions for configured blocks, dropped items, and entities.

missionBlocks.title: Mission Blocks
missionBlocks.description: Selects mission-target blocks that repeatedly flash when detected.

missionItems.title: Mission Items
missionItems.description: Selects mission-target dropped items that repeatedly flash when detected.

missionEntities.title: Mission Entities
missionEntities.description: Selects mission-target entity types that repeatedly flash when detected.

soundsEnabled.title: Sounds Enabled
soundsEnabled.description: Master switch for all custom Terminator HUD sounds.

entityConfirmSounds.title: Entity Confirm Sounds
entityConfirmSounds.description: Randomly plays one of three confirmation sounds when a living-entity scan is confirmed.

blockConfirmSounds.title: Block Confirm Sounds
blockConfirmSounds.description: Plays a confirmation sound when a scanned block group is confirmed.

missionSounds.title: Mission Sounds
missionSounds.description: Plays the found_it sound when a configured mission target is discovered.

healthSounds.title: Health Sounds
healthSounds.description: Plays dedicated sounds when the player takes damage or enters a low-health state.

deathSound.title: Death Sound
deathSound.description: Plays the terminator sound when the player dies.

lowHealthThreshold.title: Low Health Threshold
lowHealthThreshold.description: Plays the dying sound the first time health falls to or below this value.

soundVolume.title: Sound Volume
soundVolume.description: Sets the volume of custom Terminator HUD sounds.

deathAnimation.title: Death Animation
deathAnimation.description: On death, collapses the image into a red line and then a disappearing white point, like an old television shutdown.

deathAnimationDuration.title: Death Animation Duration
deathAnimationDuration.description: Sets the total duration of the television-style death shutdown animation.

dataList.title: Data List
dataList.description: Shows real-time position, stance, health, environment, network, and related information in the left data list.

extendedDataList.title: Extended Data List
extendedDataList.description: Adds absorption health, hunger, experience, held item, status effects, and chunk information to the left data list.

environmentGrid.title: Environment Grid
environmentGrid.description: Shows a T-800-style perspective environment scanning grid on the right side.

compass.title: Compass
compass.description: Shows cardinal direction, heading angle, and movement scale in the upper-right compass.

contextData.title: Context Data
contextData.description: Shows a context-sensitive data list on the far right that changes according to target, health, and environmental state.

extendedContextData.title: Extended Context Data
extendedContextData.description: Adds detailed target ID, coordinates, stance, volume, item, entity, and block-group information to the right context list.

Freeze.title: Freeze
Freeze.description: Freezes your position with selectable packet behavior, optional setback handling, tick replay, and compatibility safeguards.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Selects the position-freeze mode.

disableOnFlag.title: Disable On Flag
disableOnFlag.description: Automatically disables Freeze when a server position-correction packet is received.

notification.title: Notification
notification.description: Sends a chat notification when the server flags/corrects your position.

balance.title: Balance
balance.description: When Freeze is disabled, replays lost ticks to rebalance player tick timing.

bypassNegativeTimer.title: Bypass Negative Timer
bypassNegativeTimer.description: When disabling Freeze, performs one item interaction to work around negative-timer detection.

cancelC0B.title: Cancel C0 B
cancelC0B.description: Cancels CommonPongC2SPacket to work around Grim BadPacketsR checks.

freezeLookSilent.title: Freeze Look Silent
freezeLookSilent.description: Silently freezes server rotation while still allowing the client camera to turn locally.

maceMode.title: Mace Mode
maceMode.description: In Stationary mode, slowly moves downward to accumulate server-side fallDistance so mace attacks can receive critical fall damage.

driftSpeed.title: Drift Speed
driftSpeed.description: Sets downward movement per tick. For example, 0.05 equals about one block per second and accumulates fallDistance.

maxDrift.title: Max Drift
maxDrift.description: Sets the maximum total downward drift. Drifting stops at this distance and resets after a server S08 position correction.

BMWSprint.title: BMW Sprint
BMWSprint.description: BMWClient-nextgen-derived sprint module with omnidirectional rotation and controls for blindness, hunger, walls, ground, air, and elytra movement.

ignoreBlindness.title: Ignore Blindness
ignoreBlindness.description: Keeps sprinting while affected by blindness.

ignoreHunger.title: Ignore Hunger
ignoreHunger.description: Keeps sprinting while hunger would normally prevent sprinting.

ignoreCollision.title: Ignore Collision
ignoreCollision.description: Keeps sprinting while colliding with a wall.

stopOnGround.title: Stop On Ground
stopOnGround.description: In Legit mode, stops sprinting on the ground when there is no forward movement input.

stopOnAir.title: Stop On Air
stopOnAir.description: In Legit mode, stops sprinting in the air when there is no forward movement input.

elytraRotation.title: Elytra Rotation
elytraRotation.description: Also uses Omnirotational rotation during elytra flight so fireworks accelerate along the current WASD movement direction.

AutoVault.title: Auto Vault
AutoVault.description: Automatically selects the matching vault key and opens nearby vaults in manual or automatic mode.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Selects vault operation: Manual triggers on right-click; Auto opens the vault you are looking at automatically.

swapMode.title: Swap Mode
swapMode.description: Selects key swapping: Inventory performs a silent inventory swap; Hotbar switches the selected hotbar slot.

inventorySwap.title: Inventory Swap
inventorySwap.description: Allows silently swapping the required key from the main inventory.

range.title: Range
range.description: Sets the maximum interaction distance.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Sets the action interval in Auto mode, in milliseconds.

ScreenActions.title: Screen Actions
ScreenActions.description: Lets custom keybinds perform block placement, breaking, interaction, item use, or entity attacks while an inventory or container GUI is open.

range.title: Interaction Range
range.description: Sets the maximum interaction distance for the crosshair target.

autoSearch.title: Auto Search
autoSearch.description: When placing a block, automatically searches the hotbar for a suitable block and can also use an item currently held by the mouse cursor.

instantBreak.title: Instant Break
instantBreak.description: When breaking, sends the STOP destroy packet immediately to request instant completion.

action1.title: Action1
action1.description: Selects the action1 option used by Screen Actions.

key1.title: Key1
key1.description: Sets the keybind for key1 in Screen Actions.

action2.title: Action2
action2.description: Selects the action2 option used by Screen Actions.

key2.title: Key2
key2.description: Sets the keybind for key2 in Screen Actions.

action3.title: Action3
action3.description: Selects the action3 option used by Screen Actions.

key3.title: Key3
key3.description: Sets the keybind for key3 in Screen Actions.

action4.title: Action4
action4.description: Selects the action4 option used by Screen Actions.

key4.title: Key4
key4.description: Sets the keybind for key4 in Screen Actions.

MobHud.title: Mob HUD
MobHud.description: Smart HUD for weather, temperature, speed, altitude, looked-at entity details, warnings, navigation, and command feedback.

hudColor.title: HUD Color
hudColor.description: Sets the color of HUD text and borders.

aiName.title: AI Name
aiName.description: Sets the AI name recognized by chat commands. Matching is case-insensitive.

textBoxEnabled.title: Text Box Enabled
textBoxEnabled.description: Draws a semi-transparent dark background with a one-pixel black border around HUD text.

showWeather.title: Show Weather
showWeather.description: Controls whether show Weather is shown by Mob HUD.

showEntityInfo.title: Show Entity Info
showEntityInfo.description: Controls whether show Entity Info is shown by Mob HUD.

showSpeed.title: Show Speed
showSpeed.description: Controls whether show Speed is shown by Mob HUD.

showAltitude.title: Show Altitude
showAltitude.description: Controls whether show Altitude is shown by Mob HUD.

showVitals.title: Show Vitals
showVitals.description: Controls whether show Vitals is shown by Mob HUD.

showNavigation.title: Show Navigation
showNavigation.description: Controls whether show Navigation is shown by Mob HUD.

showToggleMessage.title: Show Toggle Message
showToggleMessage.description: Shows on-screen feedback after a chat command changes a HUD option.

entityRange.title: Entity Range
entityRange.description: Sets the maximum detection distance for the entity currently under your crosshair.

LavaESP.title: Lava Leak Warning
LavaESP.description: Predicts blocks that may release lava when mined and renders 3D warnings plus directional arrows toward lava sources.

range.title: Range
range.description: Sets the detection range in blocks.

dangerColors.title: Danger Colors
dangerColors.description: Automatically changes warning colors according to danger level. When disabled, the shared colors below are used instead.

sphere.title: Sphere
sphere.description: Shows a 3D block outline at predicted lava-leak positions.

sphereColor.title: Sphere Color
sphereColor.description: Sets the block-outline color used when danger-level coloring is disabled.

arrow.title: Arrow
arrow.description: Shows an arrow pointing toward the source direction of the predicted lava flow.

text.title: Text
text.description: Shows danger-warning text above the predicted block.

textColor.title: Text Color
textColor.description: Sets warning-text color when danger-level coloring is disabled.

CustomFishingBot.title: Custom Fishing Bot
CustomFishingBot.description: Experimental automation for a server-specific fishing minigame, including timing and click controls.

verboseLog.title: Verbose Log
verboseLog.description: Prints detailed fishing-bot logs to chat.

actionInterval.title: Action Interval
actionInterval.description: Sets the interval between automated actions in ticks, where one tick is 50 ms.

maxWaitTicks.title: Max Wait Ticks
maxWaitTicks.description: Sets the maximum time to wait for a bite in ticks, where 20 ticks equals one second.

cooldownTicks.title: Cooldown Ticks
cooldownTicks.description: Sets the wait time after reeling in, in ticks.

acClickDelay.title: AC Click Delay
acClickDelay.description: Sets the ACCURATE_CLICK delay in ticks so the pointer can enter a high-probability region before clicking.

FurnaceUnclogger.title: Furnace Unclogger
FurnaceUnclogger.description: Scans nearby furnaces, removes non-smeltable items blocking their input slots, and renders through-wall markers for suspected or confirmed clogged furnaces.

autoClean.title: Auto Clean
autoClean.description: When enabled, actively scans and automatically opens nearby furnaces to clear blocked input slots. When disabled, it only cleans furnaces that you open manually. Render markers are unaffected by this switch.

cleanMode.title: Clean Mode
cleanMode.description: Selects what happens to a blocking item after removal: move it into your inventory or drop it on the ground.

probeOnlyUnlit.title: Probe Only Unlit
probeOnlyUnlit.description: Automatically opens only furnaces that are not currently burning, greatly reducing GUI flicker in large furnace arrays.

interactRange.title: Interact Range
interactRange.description: Automatically opens a furnace waiting for inspection once you come within this distance.

scanRange.title: Scan Range
scanRange.description: Scans furnaces already loaded by the client for automatic inspection and long-distance marking.

operationMessages.title: Operation Messages
operationMessages.description: Shows a short chat message when a cleaning operation succeeds or fails.

normalFurnace.title: Normal Furnace
normalFurnace.description: Includes normal furnaces in scanning and cleaning.

blastFurnace.title: Blast Furnace
blastFurnace.description: Includes blast furnaces in scanning and cleaning.

smoker.title: Smoker
smoker.description: Includes smokers in scanning and cleaning.

scanInterval.title: Scan Interval
scanInterval.description: Sets how many ticks pass between refreshes of the loaded-furnace list.

recheckDelay.title: Recheck Delay
recheckDelay.description: After a furnace has been checked, waits at least this many ticks before checking it again.

openTimeout.title: Open Timeout
openTimeout.description: After interacting with a furnace, waits at most this many ticks for the server to open its screen.

inspectDelay.title: Inspect Delay
inspectDelay.description: After the furnace screen opens, waits this many ticks before reading the input slot so the inventory has time to synchronize.

actionDelay.title: Action Delay
actionDelay.description: Number of ticks to wait between automatic pickup, inventory transfer, or drop actions. Use 2-4 on higher-latency servers.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries when the server does not accept the item-removal action.

closeDelay.title: Close Delay
closeDelay.description: After confirming that the operation is complete, waits this many ticks before closing the furnace screen.

renderConfirmed.title: Render Confirmed
renderConfirmed.description: Draws a red box around furnaces that were opened and confirmed to still be clogged.

renderSuspected.title: Render Suspected
renderSuspected.description: Draws an orange box around extinguished furnaces waiting to be inspected. Orange marks are candidates only and do not necessarily mean the furnace is clogged.

renderDistance.title: Render Distance
renderDistance.description: Maximum distance, in blocks, at which markers for loaded furnaces are rendered.

renderMode.title: Render Mode
renderMode.description: Chooses whether furnace markers render as filled boxes, outlines, or both.

confirmedSideColor.title: Confirmed Side Color
confirmedSideColor.description: Fill color used for furnaces confirmed to be clogged.

confirmedLineColor.title: Confirmed Line Color
confirmedLineColor.description: Outline color used for furnaces confirmed to be clogged.

suspectedSideColor.title: Suspected Side Color
suspectedSideColor.description: Fill color used for extinguished furnaces waiting to be inspected.

suspectedLineColor.title: Suspected Line Color
suspectedLineColor.description: Outline color used for extinguished furnaces waiting to be inspected.

BreakESP.title: Break ESP
BreakESP.description: Alien V4-derived mining ESP that renders information about blocks currently being broken.

damage.title: Damage
damage.description: Damage multiplier for break time calculation.

ease.title: Ease
ease.description: Easing mode for the box animation.

friendBoxColor.title: Friend Box Color
friendBoxColor.description: Color of the box outline for friends.

friendFillColor.title: Friend Fill Color
friendFillColor.description: Color of the fill for friends.

secondBoxToggle.title: Second Box Toggle
secondBoxToggle.description: Show box outline for second break.

secondBoxColor.title: Second Box Color
secondBoxColor.description: Color of the second box outline.

secondFillToggle.title: Second Fill Toggle
secondFillToggle.description: Show filled box for second break.

textScaleBase.title: Text Scale Base
textScaleBase.description: Sets the base text scale at zero distance. The default is 5.0.

textScaleFactor.title: Text Scale Factor
textScaleFactor.description: Sets how much text scale increases per block of distance. The default is 0.1.

EnglishUITranslation.title: English Translation
EnglishUITranslation.description: Translates IMG module names, setting groups, setting names, and descriptions into English without changing configuration IDs.

autoEnableForNonChinese.title: Auto Enable for Non-Chinese
autoEnableForNonChinese.description: Automatically enables this translation module when the Minecraft language is anything other than Simplified Chinese (zh_cn) or Traditional Chinese (zh_tw).

settings.description: Controls whether Preset $1 is included when Tactical Hotbar cycles through presets.
Selects the item assigned to this hotbar slot in the current preset.

descriptions.replacement: Selects the item for slot $2 in Preset $1.
